title: SDP observation components metadata schema
description: Ordered bindings from table columns to the measure, dimensions, and attributes of a logical observation structure.

fields.name: component_order
fields.description: One-based component order within the structure.

fields.name: column_name
fields.description: Exact name of the bound column in the referenced data table.

fields.name: component_role
fields.description: Structural role of the column for this measure-specific observation.

fields.name: component_relation_iri
fields.description: Optional absolute IRI for a more specific relationship between the observation and this component, such as sosa:usedProcedure for a row-varying procedure attribute.

fields.name: required_when_observed
fields.description: TRUE when this component must be non-empty whenever the structure's measure value is non-empty.

sdp:rowRule: One row per bound column. Dimensions define measure grain; attributes describe observations without changing grain.
